description: Kardia echo view catalogue. Target planes for the probe guidance drill in WP4 and WP10. All vectors use a patient fixed frame where x points to patient left, y points anterior, z points cranial. Normals and up vectors are approximate unit vectors. Plane normal points out of the image plane. Up vector points to the top of the displayed sector. Landmark refs starting with FJ or LIVE are BodyParts3D part ids from atlas/3d/manifest.json. All other refs are parametric structures defined in parametricStructures below because BodyParts3D has no mesh for them. British spelling throughout.
